title: New Moon in Pisces
tldr: A seed point for dreams, compassion, intuition, rest, spiritual trust, and the wisdom beyond control.
theme: Pisces is a mutable water sign ruled traditionally by Jupiter. This New Moon begins work around dreams, compassion, intuition, rest, spiritual trust, and the wisdom beyond control.
shadow: escape disguised as surrender, porous boundaries, fantasy that avoids reality
integration: letting flow have enough structure to become healing instead of drift

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc shows where structure will set the dream free.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Pisces; watch what the Virgo Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Jupiter kamea, yellow or white candle, citrine, turquoise or green jasper, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Pisces. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through dreams, compassion, intuition, rest, spiritual trust, and the wisdom beyond control, without repeating the shadow of escape disguised as surrender, porous boundaries, fantasy that avoids reality?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Pisces intention take form?
